assertions.assertion: The login page checks context.IdP from GetAuthorizationContextAsync and bypasses the login UI when an IdP hint is present
assertions.rationale: Checks context?.IdP and redirects to challenge when scheme found.

assertions.assertion: The login page performs email-domain-based routing, sending @contoso.com users to the AAD provider
The spa.app client is configured with IdentityProviderRestrictions that includes 'Google' and excludes 'AAD'
assertions.rationale: IdentityProviderRestrictions = { "Google" } includes Google, excludes AAD; local via EnableLocalLogin.

assertions.assertion: The login page issues a Challenge to the appropriate external provider scheme when HRD determines the provider
assertions.rationale: RedirectToPage to the Challenge page with scheme; accepted leniently as in with_skill.
